reason: Release proposal v1 for SDLC-13 (search tasks by title) for accepted candidate 03eaed98fb20ed054cf6d10a563b7d252dee9659 on the local-pilot profile. It contains user-facing release notes, a pre-merge checklist, 15 smoke steps that cover AC1 to AC6, title-only scope and no persistence, and a revert-based rollback that needs no data cleanup. The pre-merge checklist carries forward the one open minor item, placeholder WCAG AA contrast (review/verification F1), for a human to check and decide. Note 104845 (placeholder instead of label) is already in approved spec v002; the release notes describe it as the approved exception for the Search input only.
